command.videoplayer.help.audio.detail: stereo downmixes multichannel audio for two-channel output. auto lets the playback backend and system choose the output layout. Changes are saved locally and require a Minecraft restart to take effect.
command.videoplayer.help.backend.detail: Only newly started videos use the selected backend. MPV requires its native runtime.
command.videoplayer.help.biliauth.detail: login opens QR login. set expects one browser Cookie header such as SESSDATA=value; bili_jct=value; buvid3=value; buvid4=value. Do not paste a Netscape cookie file or include a Cookie: prefix. SESSDATA and bili_jct are the important account fields; buvid3 and buvid4 are optional.
command.videoplayer.help.brightness.deta: The value is a percentage and is persisted in the client configuration.
command.videoplayer.help.boot.detail: Use this to install or repair native VLC/MPV runtimes and configure network options.
command.videoplayer.help.createarea.deta: Requires a server connection and the server permission to create areas. Coordinates are world coordinates.
command.videoplayer.help.createscreen.de: The area must be loaded and the server must grant screen-create permission. Use "" as source for an independent screen; otherwise source is another real screen name.
command.videoplayer.help.danmaku.detail: Requires a server connection. The setting applies to the local client.
command.videoplayer.help.diagnostics.det: Opens muted for review and requires permission to open the selected screen menu.
command.videoplayer.help.header: VideoPlayer client commands. Use /videoplayer help <subcommand> for details.
command.videoplayer.help.help.detail: Use /videoplayer help <subcommand> for usage, ranges, and prerequisites. /vlc remains a compatible alias.
command.videoplayer.help.list.detail: Requires a current screen inside a loaded video area.
command.videoplayer.help.play.detail: Requires a server connection and a current screen. The URL must be supported by the configured provider.
command.videoplayer.help.playthat.detail: The area and screen must be loaded, and the target screen must be interactable.
command.videoplayer.help.removearea.deta: The named area must be loaded and the server must grant the remove permission.
command.videoplayer.help.removescreen.de: The area and screen must be loaded and the server must grant screen-remove permission.
command.videoplayer.help.scale.detail: Requires looking at an interactable screen. set accepts values from 1/16 to 16.
command.videoplayer.help.setmeta.detail: The area and screen must be loaded. Built-in keys and custom metadata are subject to server validation and permissions.
command.videoplayer.help.slice.detail: Requires looking at an interactable screen. UV values are floating-point coordinates.
command.videoplayer.help.skip.detail: The current screen or the named screen must exist. force=true bypasses the normal vote when permitted.
command.videoplayer.help.skippercent.det: The value is a ratio from 0 to 1.01 and is sent to the server.
command.videoplayer.help.stop.detail: Requires a current screen inside a loaded video area.
command.videoplayer.help.sync.detail: Requires a current screen and a server connection.
command.videoplayer.help.unknown: Unknown subcommand '%s'. Use /videoplayer help to list available commands.
command.videoplayer.help.volume.detail: The value is a percentage. It is persisted in the client configuration.
command.videoplayer.help.youtubeauth.det: login opens the YouTube authentication screen. Configure either a Netscape cookies.txt file exported from your browser or a yt-dlp browser profile such as chrome:Default. A raw Cookie header is not accepted. When both are set, cookies.txt takes priority. The setting is local and used by yt-dlp for age-restricted videos, account access, and live streams. youtube-auth is an alias.
